name: Hindsight
description: Gives agents a self-hosted long-term memory server that retains facts, recalls them with parallel semantic, keyword, graph, and time search, and reflects over them, via SDKs, REST, and MCP.

skills.name: Retain Memories
skills.description: Stores new information in a memory bank, using an LLM to extract facts, entities, relationships, and timestamps into search indexes.

skills.name: Recall Memories
skills.description: Searches a bank with semantic, BM25 keyword, graph, and temporal retrieval in parallel, then fuses and reranks results to a token limit.

skills.name: Reflect Over Memories
skills.description: Analyzes existing memories to answer questions that need reasoning rather than lookup, shaped by the bank's disposition traits.

skills.name: Mental Models
skills.description: Keeps standing answers and wiki-style knowledge pages for a bank that Hindsight rewrites in the background as the bank learns more.

skills.name: Coding Agent Memory
skills.description: Installs per-repo memory into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other CLI agents, built from git history and past sessions automatically.
